title: Discovery 2 — which currencies exist on the Hub (no credentials)
description: Each fiat symbol mapped to its Hub W-token address and the Central Bank that registered it. Costa Rica and Chile are both present, so the corridor can exist.
notes: Gateway: any. Divergence, documented in contracts/amm and verified in the delivered handler: the platform document declares a bare JSON array; the gateway returns a wrapped {"currencies": [...]} object. A client deserialising into an array per the document fails. The same wrapping divergence applies to /api/v2/amm/pairs and /api/v2/bridge/positions.
